title: Pre-registration addendum 1 (exploratory follow-up runs): Enforcing Document Permissions in Vector Search, an Experimental Comparison
description: Addendum 1 to the pre-registration deposited at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24026269 (release prereg-v1 of this repository). It registers exploratory follow-up runs before any of them ran: each store's filter and the post-filters at three settings of search breadth (ef 40, 100 and 400) and pgvector with a raised iterative-scan limit; the cost of looking up a user's principals in SpiceDB or OpenFGA for the arms that filter in the store; p50 and p99 latency per job; and a diagnostic of the permission-change protocol with the same pause before grants and revocations and SpiceDB's at_least_as_fresh and fully_consistent reads. The addendum is prereg/addendum-1.md; this version archives the repository at the release it was made from. The measured results it follows are release results-v1 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24055691). It changes nothing in the original registration. Code and history: https://github.com/muzakkirhussain011/rag-permission-bench. The study includes wardowl, the author's own library, as one arm; this is a declared conflict of interest.
